sources.locator: "Partition of India", revision 1374133022, § Labour victory in the UK election, decision to decolonize: 1945

explanation: The English article says the exchequer of the Attlee government sworn in after the 1945 election had been exhausted by the Second World War and that the British public did not appear enthusiastic about costly distant involvements; late in 1945 the government decided to end the British Raj, and in early 1947 announced its intention to transfer power no later than June 1948. The article hangs that sentence on Metcalf and Metcalf 2006, page 212 — though victorious in war, Britain had suffered immensely and simply did not possess the manpower or economic resources required to coerce a restive India — which is the second author here.
